title: Flamingo dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="93" rx="32" ry="4" fill="#2a1a2e"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d="M38 82 L36 92 L42 92" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 80 L62 90 L56 90" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#ff5c9e"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="62" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#ffa8d2"/>
  <!-- wing raised -->
  <path d="M36 62 Q22 46 34 38 Q40 44 44 54 Z" fill="#ff8cc0"/>
  <path d="M34 40 Q28 48 36 58" stroke="#ffc2dc" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d="M66 58 Q76 46 70 32 Q66 24 58 24" stroke="#ff5c9e" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="56" cy="22" r="8" fill="#ff5c9e"/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d="M50 22 Q44 22 42 26 Q46 28 50 28 Z" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <path d="M42 26 L44 27" stroke="#ffb238" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="58" cy="20" r="2" fill="#2a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="58.7" cy="19.4" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <path d="M28 62 Q18 58 20 68 Q26 68 30 66 Z" fill="#ff8cc0"/>
  <path d="M27 69 Q16 68 19 77 Q27 76 30 72 Z" fill="#ffa8d2"/>
  <!-- second foot/leg bent (dancing) -->
  <path d="M64 78 Q72 76 74 82 Q72 86 66 84" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <!-- little musical notes for fun -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="40" r="2.2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <path d="M82 40 L82 31 L88 33" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="30" r="1.8" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <path d="M36 30 L36 23 L41 24" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/>
</svg>
